title: Adding a choice tape
statement: Given a configuration of a machine with $k$ work tapes on a Boolean input, a tape content function from the integers to optional Boolean values, and an integer head position, form a configuration with $k+1$ work tapes by appending that tape and head position as the last work tape. The state, input-head position, and output are unchanged.
hypotheses_covered: A natural number $k$ of work tapes
A configuration on a Boolean input
A choice-tape content function from the integers to optional Booleans
